title: Shortest Route With One Discount
description: An undirected connected graph has `n` vertices and positive weighted edges `[u,v,cost]`. Travel costs `cost`, except that you may choose at most one edge on your route and pay `floor(cost/2)` for it. Return the minimum possible cost from `source` to `destination`. Input: `n`, `edges`, `source`, `destination`. Output: the minimum cost.
constraints: The graph is connected and has no parallel edges
hints: Represent each edge as a transition whose cost matches the route rule.
Keep the best distance for each required state and ignore stale priority-queue entries.
